Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

seny 0.99.0

First Bioconductor submission.

  • Per-comparison adequacy calls (Adequate / Underpowered / Caution / Invalid) for pseudobulk differential expression, each with its reason: design and confounding (layer 1), pseudobulk quality and cell imbalance (layer 2), and variance structure and power at a target effect (layer 4), with edgeR, DESeq2 and voom.
  • The composition layer: subtype shifts within a cluster, the expected number of DEGs they produce on their own, and attribution of the cluster’s DEGs.
  • Count matrices beyond one sparse matrix (a DelayedMatrix, HDF5-backed) are checked and summed a block of cells at a time.
  • Plots: the traffic-light matrix (plotAdequacy()), the comparison card (plotComparison()) and the plotX() family.

Developed by Samuel Morabito.

Site built with pkgdown 2.2.1.
